title: Artemio Perez
text: I am an Industrial Engineering student at the University of Arkansas with an interest in using data and analytics to solve real-world problems. Alongside my coursework, I work full time at Paleteria Standard De Penjamo, learning and understanding how operations run day to day. My upcoming project will be completed at Hack Midwest, a hackathon in Kansas City. After completing my undergraduate degree, I plan to pursue a career in operations.
